jobs.title: Quality Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu wachsen. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. Als Quality Engineering Lead führst und entwickelst du ein Team von Quality Engineers und trägst dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit der Commerce-Plattform von Shopware zu verbessern. Du verbindest Mitarbeiterführung mit praktischer Arbeit in den Bereichen Testing und Automatisierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering- und Produktteams zusammen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Entwicklung sowie Veröffentlichung unserer Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du übersetzt Unternehmensziele und Produktprioritäten in eine Quality-Engineering-Roadmap mit klaren und messbaren Verbesserungszielen. Du setzt Prioritäten, delegierst Aufgaben und stellst dich direkt komplexen Herausforderungen im Testing. Führe, unterstütze und entwickle das Team durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Mitarbeitergespräche und individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Unterstütze außerdem bei der Einstellung und beim Onboarding. Definiere gemeinsam mit den Engineering-Kolleg:innen die Teststrategie und Qualitätsstandards für die Produktteams. Priorisiere und verteile Quality-Engineering-Aufgaben entsprechend den Produktrisiken, Roadmap-Zielen und Teamkapazitäten. Arbeite aktiv an Testdesign, Testautomatisierung und explorativem Testing mit. Unterstütze bei der Analyse komplexer Fehler und validiere Änderungen, die mehrere Produktbereiche betreffen. Unterstütze Quality Engineers, Entwickler:innen und Product Manager teamübergreifend bei der Umsetzung der Teststrategie und dabei, Qualität frühzeitig in Planung und Entwicklung zu berücksichtigen. Verbessere Testwerkzeuge und -praktiken, einschließlich des verantwortungsvollen Einsatzes KI-gestützter Tests. Nutze Kundenprobleme, Fehler und die Zuverlässigkeit von Tests, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren. Unterstütze Produkt-Releases, indem du Testergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken und eine klare Qualitätsempfehlung an die für den Release koordinierenden Kolleg:innen kommunizierst. Das bringst du mit: Erfahrung in der Führung eines technischen Teams, einschließlich Coaching, Performance-Gesprächen und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, in der Entwicklung von Teststrategien und in der Testautomatisierung, einschließlich Ansätzen wie End-to-End-, API-, Integrations- oder Komponententests. Erfahrung in der Definition und Präsentation von Qualitätsmetriken sowie darin, diese gemeinsam mit Testergebnissen und Risikobewertungen zu nutzen, um Lücken zu erkennen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. Die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Aufgaben zu delegieren und effektiv mit Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Engineering und Produkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte und Abwägungen verständlich zu erklären. Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Hilfreich, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich Erfahrung im E-Commerce, mit Open-Source-Software, Cloud-Anwendungen, Upgrades und Migrationen sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung und Testautomatisierung ist von Vorteil. Vorkenntnisse in Shopware sind nicht erforderlich. Wir begrüßen vielfältige Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in allen genannten Bereichen Erfahrung haben, um dich zu bewerben. Erzähle uns, wie dich dein bisheriger Werdegang darauf vorbereitet hat, ein Team zu führen und die Softwarequalität zu verbessern. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite . Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung! jobs.title: Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator (all genders)
jobs.description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company, revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe. About the team You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director. Your mission As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator , you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis. Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader . You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment. Responsibilities Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives. Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities. Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day. Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency. Flight Execution & Safety Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards. Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity. Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics. Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards. Test Design & Data Analysis Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA). Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements. Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance. Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked. Qualifications Educational & Legal Background Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering. NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations). Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English. Technical & Leadership Toolkit Coordination Skills: Proven ability to lead a technical team on-site (three pilots and one engineer), manage schedules, and communicate priorities clearly under pressure. Data Mastery: Practical experience in data reduction and analysis using MATLAB or Python . UAV Systems: Familiarity with Ground Control Stations (GCS), telemetry systems, and mission planning tools. Testing Rigor: Proven ability to plan and conduct system-level tests in an aerospace or defense environment. Mindset & Style The "General" Mindset: You are naturally organized and can work through ambiguity on the flight line. Analytical & Decisive: You can analyze a data anomaly quickly and decide whether to continue testing. Meticulous Documenter: You believe that if it wasn't documented with high fidelity, the test never happened. Preferred Experience Active experience with uncrewed aviation. Hands-on experience with flight test instrumentation (FTI) and DAQ systems. Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation environments. jobs.title: Growth Marketer (AI-Powered QA Automation)
jobs.description: Do you care about building a user base from scratch, testing unproven acquisition channels, and implementing wild ideas beyond paid search? Are you enthusiastic about shipping now, preferring to go live with rough ideas today over polishing presentations for next month? If so, this is the role for you. In this role, you’ll join the team building Qure , an AI copilot for web testing automation. This desktop app turns manual testing flows into production-ready automated scripts, saving hours of manual coding. We’re a seven-person team funded directly by JetBrains. About JetBrains Innovation Hub JetBrains builds software development tools used by more than 15 million people, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100. Innovation Hub is its internal startup incubator, where small autonomous teams build new products, funded and employed by JetBrains. Qure runs inside the Innovation Hub with its own roadmap, go-to-market strategy, and customers. For you, that means a founding role without the runway risk. You build acquisition from zero, with the funding, benefits, and stability of an established company behind you. What you’ll do Qure is a fresh product, so the acquisition channel map is practically blank. Paid search, video, newsletters, marketplaces, paid communities, and content are all unproven for Qure. We need someone to determine how best to find its audience. With a high degree of freedom, a lean team, and no marketing bureaucracy, decisions you make on Monday go live by Wednesday. Day to day, you will: Run parallel channel experiments across paid search, video, communities, and organic traffic to discover what actually converts. Shut down underperforming channels early using your own data to ground the decision. Produce your own marketing assets, including ad copy, screen recordings, and landing pages. Work directly with the product team to ship acquisition-focused product requirements, such as custom onboarding flows or free tools. Build and maintain end-to-end funnel tracking, from a user’s initial click to aha moment to LTV. What you’ll bring Comfort operating without a playbook and deciding what to test when acquisition channels are entirely unproven. Honesty about performance, with the discipline to cut underperforming channels based on data before anyone asks you to. A bias for action that favors shipping functional campaigns quickly over prolonged polishing. What you’ll need Demonstrated success growing self-serve products with direct responsibility for user activation. Experience managing marketing budgets across channels and reallocating spending based on user acquisition economics. The capability to create your own creative assets – including copy, landing pages, and product demos – without relying on external agencies or designers. Daily experience using LLMs in your own work for research, creative drafting, and data analysis, with the judgment to know when they help or hinder work. Experience working inside a startup or a small, fast-moving product team. Experience doing marketing for developer tools, QA products, or AI tools is a plus.

critical_skills_to_learn.reason: Cypress is heavily requested across senior QA job postings. Given your strong background in Playwright and TypeScript, picking up Cypress will complete your modern Web Automation portfolio and eliminate your single biggest skill match gap.

trending_in_qa: AI-driven Test Automation & Code Generation (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor)

certifications_recommended.cert: ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer (CTAL-TAE)
certifications_recommended.reason: Complements your 13 years of experience and formalizes your capability to design, build, and maintain enterprise automation architectures.
Validates cloud infrastructure competence, crucial for modern senior QA Engineers designing cloud-native testing environments and CI/CD pipelines.

quick_wins: Build a quick open-source Cypress + TypeScript test suite on GitHub showcasing API and UI automation to close the observed job gap immediately.
Reframe your resume to emphasize high-level architectural metrics (e.g., reduction in build times, pipeline stability, cost savings) suitable for 13+ years of experience.
Highlight your multi-platform versatility (Web, Mobile, API, Performance, CI/CD) prominently in your LinkedIn summary.
skill_gap.career_advice: With 13 years of experience and a rich tech stack covering Java, TypeScript, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, K6, and CI/CD pipelines, you are well beyond a standard Senior QA level. Target Staff QA Engineer, QA Architect, or Lead SDET roles. Learning Cypress will bridge your only notable automation gap. Shift your narrative from writing test scripts to driving quality strategy, mentoring teams, and building scalable quality engineering systems.
